rules.split: An issue gets real sub-issues (each with its own branch) only when it is size L and its parts can be reviewed on their own. Everything else is one branch with a task checklist.
rules.releases: Three releases: v0.2.0 (reliable and measured), v0.5.0 (CI/CD and improved models), v1.0.0 (fast, observable, documented).

labels.name: type: experiment
labels.description: Measured ML experiment with a report

milestones.title: M1 — Foundation: Workflow, Fixes & Tests
milestones.description: Workflow in place, no request can crash a service, pytest suite covers units, APIs and failure paths.

milestones.title: M2 — Evaluation Baseline
milestones.description: Labelled eval set and harness; detection, grouping and latency baseline with confidence intervals.

milestones.title: M3 — CI/CD & Docker
milestones.description: Tests, lint, Docker builds and eval gate on every PR; images and releases published automatically; weights out of git.

milestones.title: M4 — Model R&D
milestones.description: Detector fine-tuned on SKU-110K, grouping experiments, best models promoted manually with model cards.

milestones.title: M5 — Performance & Observability
milestones.description: Lower latency measured against the baseline; Prometheus, Grafana and Jaeger.

milestones.title: M6 — Documentation & v1.0.0
milestones.description: Docs that match the code, walkthrough, changelog, v1.0.0.

milestones.title: Later — Automated Training Pipeline
milestones.description: Optional. Start only after one model has been promoted manually in M4.

issues.title: Workflow setup and repository hygiene
issues.summary: Put the workflow in writing, make GitHub enforce it, and stop committing generated files.
tasks: Move templates into .github/ (issue templates + PR template)
Add docs/workflow/WORKFLOW.md and a short CONTRIBUTING.md
Run scripts/github/bootstrap.py to create labels, milestones and issues
Protect main: PR required, no force-push (CI checks added in M3)
Update .gitignore (data/, runs/, mlruns/, checkpoints) and add .env.example for every env var
Add pre-commit with ruff and nbstripout
acceptance: Templates render on GitHub; roadmap issues exist on board #6 with Priority and Size
main is protected
.env.example matches all os.getenv calls; pre-commit run --all-files passes

issues.title: Validate input and return safe errors
issues.summary: Corrupt or oversized uploads crash the detector (cv2.imdecode returns None) and services return raw exception text.
tasks: Gateway: MAX_UPLOAD_MB limit, content-type and decode check before calling detector
Detector and grouping: validate payloads; 500 responses carry only an error id
Gateway: REQUEST_TIMEOUT from env; downstream timeout → 504, other failure → 502
acceptance: Corrupt/non-image upload → 400; too large → 413; no stack traces or exception text in any response
Each case covered by a test

issues.title: Fix grouping edge cases and preprocessing
issues.summary: One detection crashes AgglomerativeClustering; ResNet input lacks ImageNet normalisation; embeddings run one crop at a time.
tasks: Handle 0 and 1 detections
Add ImageNet mean/std normalisation; use torchvision weights enum instead of pretrained=True
Batch embedding inference; move model to device once
acceptance: 0, 1 and 2 detections return valid responses (tested)
Preprocessing test checks tensor shape, dtype and value range
Note in PR: grouping output changes; re-measured in M2

issues.title: Fix detector configuration
issues.summary: MODEL_PATH default uses Windows backslashes relative to the working directory; confidence threshold is hard-coded.
tasks: Resolve MODEL_PATH relative to the repo; fail fast with a clear log if weights are missing
CONF_THRESHOLD from env; Ultralytics verbose output off
acceptance: Service starts from repo root on Windows, Linux and Docker
Missing-weights path covered by a test

issues.title: Test framework across services
issues.summary: The project has no tests. Add a pytest suite that runs fast without model weights, plus one slow end-to-end test.
acceptance: pytest runs from repo root; unit + API tests need no weights
Failure paths tested for every endpoint
README documents how to run tests

sub_issues.title: pytest setup, fake models and unit tests
acceptance: YOLO and ResNet stubbed by fixtures
sliding window, filters, NMS, spatial features, clustering covered incl. image smaller than slice and no boxes

sub_issues.title: API tests for gateway, detector and grouping
acceptance: Flask test client; downstream calls mocked; error paths asserted

sub_issues.title: End-to-end smoke test on a sample image
acceptance: marked slow; real weights; asserts response schema

issues.title: Build labelled evaluation set
issues.summary: Without ground truth no accuracy claim can be checked. Start with 20 shelf images (grown to 40+ in M4.2).
tasks: Annotation guideline: what is a product, partial products, what counts as the same SKU
Label 20 images with boxes and SKU group IDs (Label Studio or CVAT), export in a documented format
data/eval/ manifest with checksums; eval images never used for training
acceptance: docs/evaluation/annotation-guideline.md exists
20 labelled images load and pass checksum verification

issues.title: Evaluation harness and baseline report
issues.summary: One command that scores detection, grouping and latency separately, with confidence intervals so small differences are not over-claimed.
acceptance: Every metric reported with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval (resampling images)
docs/evaluation/baseline.md lists workload, environment, method and results
eval/baseline.json committed for the CI gate

sub_issues.title: Detection metrics
acceptance: precision, recall, mAP@0.5
IoU matching unit-tested

sub_issues.title: Grouping metrics on ground-truth and predicted boxes
acceptance: ARI, NMI, purity on GT boxes (isolates grouping) and on predicted boxes (end-to-end)
tested on toy data

sub_issues.title: Latency benchmark and baseline report
acceptance: fixed images, warm-up, p50/p95 per stage, peak memory
bootstrap CIs
baseline.md + baseline.json

issues.title: CI on pull requests
issues.summary: GitHub Actions on every PR into main.
tasks: ci.yml: ruff + pytest (no weights)
docker-build.yml: buildx per service with GitHub Actions cache
eval-gate.yml: CPU eval on a small fixed subset, compared with eval/baseline.json using eval/gate.yaml tolerances
Add these as required checks on main
acceptance: A PR that breaks a test, a Dockerfile or drops metrics beyond tolerance cannot merge

issues.title: Improve Docker Build Time
issues.summary: Build context is the repo root with no .dockerignore, so the 1.9 GB venv is sent on every build. Images carry full OpenCV, ffmpeg and CUDA torch wheels.
tasks: Add .dockerignore (venv, data, notebooks, outputs, logs)
opencv-python-headless, CPU-only torch wheels, drop ffmpeg and unused open-clip
Record context size, image size and cold/warm rebuild time before and after
acceptance: Rebuild without dependency changes < 1 min (measured)
All services start and pass the smoke test

issues.title: CD: images, releases and model weights out of git
issues.summary: Merges to main publish images; version tags publish releases; weights become release assets.
tasks: Push images to GHCR on merge to main (sha tag) and on v* tags
release.yml on v* tags: CHANGELOG section + eval report
Weights as release assets with sha256; download script verifies before load; remove models/yolov8n.pt from git
acceptance: docker-compose can run from published images
Fresh clone downloads and verifies weights with one command

issues.title: Restructure notebooks around shared code
issues.summary: The current notebook duplicates service code. Notebooks should import the same preprocessing and metrics as the services so results transfer.
tasks: Create ml/ package (preprocessing, metrics, visualisation) used by services, harness and notebooks
Notebook conventions: numbered, parameter cell, fixed seeds, outputs stripped; experiment report template
00_data_exploration: SKU-110K and own images (resolution, objects per image, box size/aspect)
01_baseline_reproduce: reproduces eval/baseline.json
acceptance: Both notebooks run top to bottom
01 matches baseline.json within its confidence intervals

issues.title: Grow evaluation set to 40+ images
issues.summary: 20 images give wide confidence intervals. Grow the set before model decisions are made.
tasks: Label 20+ more images following the guideline, covering lighting, angle and shelf types
Re-run baseline; update baseline.md/json and gate tolerances
acceptance: 40+ labelled images
Baseline CIs reported narrower than with 20 images

issues.title: Fine-tune YOLOv8 on SKU-110K
issues.summary: Replace the COCO-pretrained detector with one trained on dense retail shelves, on the local GPU, judged on our own eval set.
acceptance: docs/experiments/EXP-001-detector-finetune.md with results table, CIs and a decision
Runs logged with params, metrics and weights hash

disk space checked before download
scripted download + conversion

issues.title: Promote best models (manual)
issues.summary: Ship the winners through config, by hand, once. This manual run is the prerequisite for automating training later.
tasks: Publish chosen weights as a release asset; pin version in config
Model cards in docs/models/ (data, training, metrics with CIs, limits, licence)
Update eval/baseline.json; before/after table in PR

Promotion steps written down (input for the Later milestone)

Accuracy within eval gate tolerance
Before/after report in docs/evaluation/
